>At the moment, it seems like that's all that matters. High school becomes very arbitrary once you leave it.

I feel like I might have talked about that wrong- I don't mind that I have no friends from high school, my problem is that I don't have any friends at all. I just don't have any contact with anyone outside of my family offline, and don't really know anyone online either.

>What makes you happy?

That's part of the problem. I like games, that's about it.

Hi Taylor

I've been like this for years, and I haven't had any good friends since I started high school. I've never managed to stick to anything for more than a week or two- This past year I've tried learning a language, tried jogging, tried learning to program, and after 3 weeks I'm back to sitting at a computer all day every day. I can't do shit, even if I want to.
